attchmntText: Jai Corp Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jai Corp Limited approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The standalone limited review report carries an unmodified opinion, while the consolidated report contains a qualified conclusion. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 32,638 lakh rupees, compared to 27,315 lakh rupees in the previous year. Profit before tax from continuing operations stood at 7,235 lakh rupees, down from 13,950 lakh rupees in the prior period. Basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations were 3.19 rupees, compared to 7.33 rupees previously. The spinning division is classified as a discontinuing operation. The board meeting commenced at 16:15 hours IST and concluded at 18:00 hours IST on November 13, 2026.
